title: Long-Term Behavioral Evaluation for Trusted Collaborator Selection via Bidirectional Mamba
abstract: arXiv:2608.25232v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective selection of trustworthy collaborators is crucial to ensuring the successful completion of collaborative tasks, which requires accurate assessments of both long-term device behavior and short-term collaborative dynamics. Consistent device behavior patterns, which are learned from historical collaborations, can be used to predict their reliability in future collaborations. translated_title: 基于双向Mamba的长期行为评估用于可信协作者选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25232v1 公告类型：新 摘要：有效选择可信协作者对于确保协作任务的成功完成至关重要，这要求准确评估长期设备行为和短期协作动态。从历史协作中学习到的一致设备行为模式可用于预测其未来协作的可靠性。然而，基于历史协作准确评估设备行为仍然具有挑战性。首先，从有限的协作历史中进行的评估仅捕捉到瞬时过去行为，无法代表设备的真实行为。其次，由于设备行为的时间依赖性，仅依赖早期协作的单向评估会失去从后续协作中学习的机会。解决这些挑战需要基于长期协作来评估设备行为，同时考虑时间依赖性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于双向Mamba的长期行为评估方法，用于可信协作者选择，解决了传统方法仅基于有限历史或单向评估的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bidirectional Mamba-based long-term behavior evaluation method for trusted collaborator selection, addressing limitations of traditional approaches that rely on limited history or unidirectional assessment.
